fixers.summary: Resumed FIXER-A work on notion.css. 9 of the 11 notion.css findings were already applied by the dead fixer (timeline, btn-toggle, ripple focus, dialog panel bg, 14px base, text-uppercase, v-sheet :not() chain/snackbar, router-link-active removal, vue-toast-notification) and were verified, not redone. Completed the contrast findings: content roles still on the 2.8:1 chrome gray (.text-overline, .v-input__counter, data footer text, date-picker year) now use --notion-text-muted; actionable/state icons (default .v-icon, icon buttons, input affordances, checkbox/radio/treeview marks, nav arrows) use --notion-text-secondary for WCAG 1.4.11; --notion-text-disabled was lifted to the theme floor (#9b9a97 / #8f8f8f). Re-anchored selected rows on .router-link-exact-active, deleted a duplicate rule, corrected token-contract comments. Prettier check passes.

Picking up the dead fixer, most of my findings were already applied; I verified each against the current tree, closed the one real gap (page.css still had 6 single `html.theme--*` scrollbar anchors) and refreshed the stale brand-red metadata in index.html. page.css now uses the dual-anchor convention everywhere (`html.theme--*` + `html .v-application.theme--*`) with token-with-fallback values, so the document gutter/overscroll canvas flips correctly even when <html> carries no theme class. sidebar.css (22 anchors), toastr.css (Roboto + legacy hexes) and the index.html inline body background were already fixed — skipped with proof. utils.css/fonts.css clean, no findings. Prettier reports all six files already formatted.

Picked up where fixer-1 died. Verified each finding against the current tree: 8 were already applied (Panel.vue, presets, settings rail, webcam form, theme mixin, logo colour, console hairlines, vuetify key rename). Fixed for real: reverted the equality-comparison constant defaultBigThumbnailBackground, gave themes.light contrast-correct primary/error/warning/success/anchor (bright set kept for dark), dropped the invisible color="white" button, swapped material red--text and text--disabled in TheConnectingDialog, anchored the console's quiet ink locally, and closed two missed dual-anchor rules. Prettier clean; no build/lint run.

fixed: notion.css .text--primary/secondary/disabled remap was inert (Vuetify's .theme--light.v-application .text--* = 0,3,0 + !important outranked 0,2,1): now anchored html .v-application.theme--light|.theme--dark = 0,3,1, verified in dist against Vuetify's emitted rule
TheTopbar.vue:485 stale #c3c2bf fallback for --notion-text-disabled -> #9b9a97 (token is now the theme gray)

Document-scrollbar dark-boot gap: added notionscrollbarthumb/notionscrollbarthumbhover hex keys to both vuetify.ts palettes (flattened composites #ababab/#878787 light, #595959/#7a7a7a dark) and mapped --notion-scrollbar-thumb/-hover through --v-*-base in notion.css section 1, so <html> resolves the active theme without waiting for App.vue's non-immediate watcher; page.css needed no change

Dual-anchored the 12 pre-existing single-anchor html.theme--light rules that could never land (MmuUnit, MmuUnitFooter, MmuFilamentStatusEncoder, MmuFilamentStatusSensor x4, MmuEditTtgMapDialogTool, Mjpegstreamer, MjpegstreamerAdaptive)

WebcamWrapperItem's `html.theme--light ::v-deep .webcamBackground` compiled to `html[data-v-*]` and was dead in BOTH themes; removed it and put the light well (var(--notion-code-bg)) in notion.css section 12 where the unscoped anchor lands
ConsoleTableEntry.vue: corrected the now-stale comment claiming the global remap never lands (rule kept as local belt-and-braces)

Gates: npm run lint clean, npx vite build clean (x3), npx prettier --check clean on every touched file, 0 single-anchor html.theme--* rules repo-wide, notion.css still imported last in App.vue:406, git diff --stat shows no deletions (39 files, +1299/-280)
gate.notesForReview: ["PR decision (not touched, logic): App.vue's @Watch('mode') at line 221 is still not { immediate: true }; that is the root cause of every dual-anchor in this reskin. Adding it would let the sheets collapse to one anchor.", "Drawer selection semantics worth a human look: Vuetify's routable passes activeClass/exactActiveClass = 'v-list-item--active', so vue-router's default router-link-active/router-link-exact-active never land on .sidebar-drawer v-list-items. That makes sidebar.css 216-266 (kept as-is) inert AND makes notion.css's `.v-list-item.router-link-exact-active` pair inert for drawer rows; the drawer's real selected state comes from .active-nav-item plus Vuetify's prefix-matched v-list-item--active, which notion.css paints.", "Scrollbar thumbs are now opaque hex (palette is hex-only: Vuetify's colorToInt rejects rgba) instead of the original translucent rgba. Composite-identical over the active canvas; differs by ~1-2% luminance over secondary surfaces (console #f7f6f3, popover #272727).", "Not added: a dedicated `notiondisabled` palette key. --notion-text-disabled resolving through --v-notiontextgray-base works; a key would be speculative until the palette owner wants it.", "Still open by design (rule 1 / store semantics): TemperaturePanelListItem.vue:167 + ...Nevermore.vue:70 '#FFFFFF' series fallback (invisible white dot on the white panel) and store/variables.ts colorArray / colorHeaterBed #2196F3 / colorChamber #4CAF50 / opacityHeaterInactive '44' remain dark-canvas tuned.", "defaultPrimaryColor '#2383e2' flips SettingsUiSettingsTab's 'reset to default' affordance for installs that persisted #2196f3; same class of issue as defaultBigThumbnailBackground (#1e1e1e, intentionally unchanged). Call out in the PR.", "index.html <meta name=\"theme-color\"> left static #ffffff - the app theme is a stored Klipper setting, not prefers-color-scheme, so a media-query twin would be wrong more often than right.", "TheSelectPrinterDialog still ships the bare `toolbar` class on each printer v-col plus toolbar-color=\"toolbar\" on Panel; inert (all palette keys are notion*-prefixed) but notion.css:1281-1289 styles those rows via .v-col.toolbar, so any rename must happen in the same change.", "notion.css:1276 `.select-printer-dialog .v-btn.white--text` kept as defence for other dialogs; no `white` palette key was re-added.", "Dev-server/screenshot verification (task #2) was not run here - only lint, build, prettier and static scans."]
skipped: sidebar.css ~216-262 drawer router-link workaround: not deleted. Verified inert (vue-router never adds router-link-active to a Vuetify routable row), so deleting changes nothing and the block documents the old false positive; owner's call.

notion.css token blocks at 33-35 / 116-117 'html.theme--light' line: already part of a triple anchor (:root + .v-application.theme--* + html.theme--*), so no change needed - handoff note #3 confirmed correct.
Timeline semantic dots: left on Vuetify's palette background on purpose (type/color props must stay meaningful); notion.css only flattens elevation/rail/typography there.
Dead 'html .v-application .v-tab--active .v-icon' duplicate: already removed by the styles lane, nothing left to do.
index.html meta theme-color / body inline background: previous lane's handling accepted (static #ffffff; inline #121212 already removed).
Temperature '#FFFFFF'/'#ffffff' series colour fallbacks and variables.ts colour/opacity constants: computed-semantics/store change, forbidden by hard rule 1.
App.vue @Watch('mode') immediate flag: script change, forbidden by hard rule 1; recorded for a human decision.
MmuUnitGate.vue / MmuFilamentStatus.vue / TheEditor.vue / Afc + Extruder + ToolheadControls + toastr.css + notion.css: lane claims verified already applied in the current tree, not redone.
npm run test:unit / dev-server visual verification: not part of the gate instructions.
gate.summary: Gate pass complete. Closed the cross-lane blocker (notion.css .text--* remap was outranked by Vuetify's 0,3,0 theme rule) and three other real items: stale #c3c2bf fallback in TheTopbar, the document-scrollbar dark-boot gap (now resolved through two new notion*-prefixed palette keys regenerated on :root), and 12 pre-existing single-anchor html.theme--light rules in MMU/webcam components that could never land - plus one scoped ::v-deep rule that was dead in both themes, relocated to notion.css. Lint, vite build and prettier --check all pass; zero single-anchor theme rules repo-wide; no component deletions.
